## Exact negative result

Adds the complete authored proof and substantive independent internal AI mathematical audit for problem 30002112 / OWR-12005-004.

For every fixed integer m>=2, bounded connected smooth domains in R^(m+1) with exactly two connected boundary components defeat every finite pair of dimension-only constants in the additive estimate

lambda_k(boundary Omega) |boundary Omega|^(2/m) <= A_m I(Omega)^(1+2/m) + B_m k^(2/m).

Here I(Omega)=|boundary Omega|/|Omega|^(m/(m+1)); the spectrum is intrinsic Laplace-Beltrami for the induced boundary metric and includes all zero modes and multiplicities, indexed from 1. The quotient with the sum of the two unweighted target terms tends to infinity. The domain itself is connected. No connected-boundary or m=1 result is claimed.

The existence inputs are credited to [Colbois-Dryden-El Soufi, Theorem 1.4 and Section 5](https://arxiv.org/abs/0909.5346), Nash and Kuiper in the [precise C0-dense embedding form](https://www.math.ias.edu/delellis/sites/math.ias.edu.delellis/files/contr_vol_Nash_11.pdf), standard smooth approximation and generalized Jordan-Brouwer separation. The authored argument supplies metric comparison, exact area and high gap in a small ball, a connected cavity domain, exact spherical mode counting and the limiting contradiction. All final boundaries are smooth. In dimension 2 topology may vary; in dimensions at least 3 the inner component may be a sphere.

The [OWR question](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2012/33) and [CEG spectrum conventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/1007.0826) were inspected in the accepted audit. Source inspection limits, including Hirsch through CDE rather than separate book retrieval, remain explicit. The complete mathematical proof and all substantive audit sections are unchanged. Editorial changes disclose review status and original/distributed provenance. Finite arithmetic diagnostics are supplementary and not proof premises.

The AI-assisted proof and independent AI audit are internally accepted and unrefereed. No external human peer review, journal acceptance, formal machine proof, novelty or priority is claimed. The known multiplicative estimate and fixed-domain Weyl asymptotics are unaffected.

This addition-only draft distributes authored mathematical prose and public acceptance/status/citation/verification metadata. No code, certificates, copied source documents/text/images, datasets, raw receipts or private coordination are included. QUEUE.md and every unrelated path are unchanged.
